def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Power-law model for log10(|ID|/A) in terms of |VGS| and |VDS| for synthetic OTFT p-channel Org3."""
    
    a = parameters[0]  # threshold voltage shift factor
    b = parameters[1]  # channel length modulation factor
    c = parameters[2]  # body effect factor
    d = parameters[3]  # constant term
    
    p = parameters[4:]  # lower order terms
    
    reduced_gate_voltage = gate_voltage_abs - a
    
    return log10((1 / (a * (reduced_gate_voltage + c * (drain_voltage_abs)**b))) + d) + np.dot(p, gate_voltage_abs)
